package arrays;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;
public class PairSum {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
int n=sc.nextInt();
int a[]=new int[n];
for(int i=0;i<n;i++) {
	a[i]=sc.nextInt();
}
int target=sc.nextInt();
Arrays.sort(a);
int left=0;
int right=n-1;
boolean f=false;
while(left<right) {
	int sum=a[left]+a[right];
	if(sum==target) {
		f=true;
		System.out.print("pair found");
		break;
	}
	else if(sum<target){
		left++;
	}
	else {
		right--;
	}
}
if(!f) {
	System.out.print("Not Found");
}

	}

}
/*Input array
↓
Arrays.sort(a)
↓
left = 0
right = n - 1
↓
while(left < right)
↓
sum = a[left] + a[right]
↓
┌──────────────┬───────────────┬──────────────┐
sum == target  sum < target    sum > target
  ↓              ↓               ↓
found=true      left++          right--
  ↓
break
↓
if(!f)
↓
Not Found*/
